'''Jopari Haines''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who worked for the company [[Genasys]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Haines had became a senior Genasys executive by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. When the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] scientist [[Higgie Sethven]] discovered a new drug and asked to join Genasys, Haines traveled to [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], to meet the scientist. He traveled in an armored vehicle and was accompanied by troopers from the [[Genasys]] Security Division. However, they were attacked by agents working for [[Culpharm]], a rival company. During the resulting fight, Haines met with the [[heroes of Cularin]] and explained the situation to them.
